description: R08 functional-debt checkpoint: close the remaining OutputCellIterator fill/run constructor family with a safe owned Rust iterator and direct Microsoft-derived witnesses.

entries.notes: OutputCellRunIterator repeats one logical full-width character as a Leading/Trailing pair per requested source repeat, matching Microsoft's five-repeat Katakana vector.
The safe fill owner emits exactly five Current-behavior narrow Q cells and then exhausts.
An unlimited character fill remains productive after Microsoft's SHORT_MAX observation window.
Attribute-only fill preserves text, emits StoredOnly behavior with the supplied legacy attribute, and exhausts at the requested limit.
Unlimited StoredOnly attribute fill remains productive beyond SHORT_MAX with the Microsoft foreground-red/background-blue attribute.
The owner emits exactly five Q cells with Stored text+attribute behavior and the supplied legacy color.
Unlimited Stored text+attribute fill remains productive beyond SHORT_MAX.
Portable LegacyCharInfo projects Microsoft's Q plus legacy WORD attributes into five Stored output cells and then exhausts.
Unlimited LegacyCharInfo fill preserves Microsoft CHAR_INFO text/attribute semantics beyond SHORT_MAX without Win32 storage.
The materialized run projects Microsoft's four legacy WORD colors to StoredOnly cells in order and exhausts after the source span.
The safe legacy CHAR_INFO run reproduces A-E with attributes 0-4, Stored behavior, source order, and finite exhaustion.
OwnedOutputCell run preserves Microsoft's five pre-materialized surrogate-pair cells, DBCS state, attributes and behavior exactly through one finite pass.
